settings.template.editor_help: Describe what the summary should do. Each line starting with ## becomes a fixed section.
settings.template.restore_help: Your changes to this template will be removed.
settings.template.delete_help: The template will be removed. Existing meeting notes will remain.
settings.template.title: Templates
settings.template.help: Choose the sections in a summary. Templates are kept as Markdown in your meeting folder.
settings.folder.label: Meeting folder
settings.speakers.downloading: Downloading the model. You can cancel it here.
settings.speakers.ready: Model ready · Sortformer, up to 4 speakers
settings.folder.title: Folder
settings.folder.help: Each meeting has a folder with Markdown and audio. Readable in Obsidian.
settings.folder.preview_help: The preview uses only its own meeting folder.
settings.folder.busy_help: Finish recording before changing the meeting folder.
settings.folder.sync_help: If you sync this folder, your meetings and audio will also go to that service.
settings.speakers.title: Speaker recognition
settings.speakers.help: Separates “Others” into individual voices after a meeting so you can name them. Runs locally.
settings.audio.title: Keep audio
settings.audio.help: Notes and transcripts are always kept.
settings.recording.detect_help: Pennel notices when a call app uses your microphone and asks whether you want to record.
settings.recording.consent: Copy the consent sentence when recording starts
settings.calendar.title: Calendar
settings.calendar.mac_help: Uses titles and participants from your Mac calendar. To include Outlook, add your work account under System Settings → Internet Accounts.
settings.calendar.help: Uses meeting titles and participants from your calendar.
settings.recording.rule_help: For example, always record your recurring standup or never record “Lunch”. These rules override calendar and app rules.
settings.recording.shortcut: Use {shortcut} to start or stop recording
settings.speakers.legacy_help: The older speaker model still works, but cannot recognize voices across meetings. Download the new speaker models to enable this.
settings.speakers.models_missing: Speaker models have not been downloaded yet.
settings.speakers.unavailable: This version of Pennel cannot recognize speakers on this device. Choose “Through Pennel Cloud”.
settings.speakers.cloud_help: Your audio is sent to Pennel Cloud, processed in memory and not stored. Sign in to Pennel Cloud to use this.
settings.speakers.local_help: Recognizes voices on your computer. Your audio stays on this device.
settings.voice.forget_help: Pennel will no longer recognize you automatically on a shared microphone. Existing meetings stay as they are.
settings.voice.forget_known_help: Pennel will no longer name this voice in new meetings. Names in existing meetings stay in place.
settings.voice.forget_all_help: Your voice and all remembered voices will be removed from this device. Names in existing meetings stay in place.
settings.speakers.identity_help: Recognizes who spoke after the meeting. Remembered voices will be named automatically in future meetings.
settings.voice.title: Your voice
settings.voice.help: Your speech stays labeled “Me”, even when everyone shares one microphone. Only a voiceprint is kept on this device, never the recording.
settings.voice.known_help: Voices you chose to remember. Pennel names them automatically in future meetings.
settings.voice.known_empty: No remembered voices yet. Name a voice in a meeting and choose “Remember this voice”.
settings.voice.unavailable: Speaker recognition on this device is unavailable in this version of Pennel. Choose “Through Pennel Cloud”.
settings.voice.intro: Pennel will recognize you as “Me”, even when everyone shares one microphone. Only a voiceprint is kept on this device, never the recording.
settings.voice.recording_status: Pennel is listening. Read the text at a comfortable pace, then press Stop.
settings.voice.working_status: Pennel is processing your voice. This takes a few seconds.
settings.voice.idle_status: Read the text aloud at your normal pace. This takes about 25 seconds.
settings.setup.overview_help: Check what is ready, or finish the setup for the task you want to do.

settings.setup.meeting_help: Keep your conversations as recordings and readable transcripts.
settings.setup.text_help: Turn a transcript into useful notes and answers. This is optional.

settings.setup.state.model: Choose a model for this task.
settings.setup.state.address: Set the address or application for this option.
settings.setup.choose_option: Choose an option above, or add another one.
settings.setup.destination: Processing: {destination}. Tests use a fixed example, never your recordings or notes.
settings.setup.saved_help: Changes are saved as you make them.
